name: interview-copilot
description: Personal live interview copilot (Parakeet-style) — system audio capture, real-time transcription, AI-generated answers, screen-share-invisible overlay.

scripts.build:backend:mac: cd backend && venv/bin/pyinstaller --onefile --name backend --collect-all websockets --collect-all uvicorn --collect-all anthropic --collect-all google.genai --collect-all openai --collect-all ollama --collect-all pypdf main.py
scripts.build:backend:win: cd backend && venv\Scripts\pyinstaller --onefile --name backend --collect-all websockets --collect-all uvicorn --collect-all anthropic --collect-all google.genai --collect-all openai --collect-all ollama --collect-all pypdf main.py
